sentences.en: Witch hazel tightens pores without drying skin.
sentences.zh: 金缕梅能收紧毛孔而不令皮肤干燥。

sentences.en: Wolverines catch a lot of hares, black grouse, hazel grouse, and small rodents.
sentences.zh: 貂熊捕食大量兔子、黑 grouse（黑松鸡）、榛鸡和小型啮齿动物。

sentences.en: The lady looked quickly up, with an angry gleam in her hazel eyes.
sentences.zh: 那位女士迅速抬头，她那双淡褐色的眼睛里闪着怒火。
